response.original_title: [FAQs-Complaint] Virgin Voyages Cruise Line Complaint & Dispute: Refund and Support Guide
response.overview: You can file a complaint or dispute a charge with Virgin Voyages by visiting the Virgin Voyages Contact Us Page or calling Sailor Services at +1-866-254-7549.Onboard Disagreements Go to the Sailor Services Onboard Payments desk on Deck 5 while on the ship. Speak directly with a deck manager  +1-866-254-7549 or guest services team member immediately to resolve folio errors or service issues before debarkation. Post-Cruise Billing and Refund Disputes Phone Support: Call the support team at +1-866-254-7549 (US). International Support: Call +1-866-254-7549 (USA) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK). Email Support: Send your booking reference, folio copies, app screenshots, and payment proof to postcruisesupport@virginvoyagescruisesusa.com. Required Evidence: Keep your booking confirmation number +1-866-254-7549, itemized receipts, and final folio statements ready.
